body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 4 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each is Distracted until the start of your next turn; choose one hit target to move 1 unit away from you.

surges.html: One hit target takes 1 Psychic Damage.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Beast
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Beast Full Manifestation (FM-1B). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
